what: Emera is a Canadian utility holding company. It owns Tampa Electric and Peoples Gas in Florida, Nova Scotia Power, and utilities in New Mexico and the Caribbean.
customers: About 2.6 million electricity and gas customers across Florida, Atlantic Canada, New Mexico and Caribbean islands.
money: New Mexico, Caribbean and gas transmission
moat: Regulated monopolies across several jurisdictions, with Florida providing the fastest-growing customer base.
risks: Debt of about $15 billion against little cash
Nova Scotia regulators capped rate increases, which hurt returns there
Hurricane damage in Florida requires recovery through later rates
Only one analyst covers it in this data and the target implies no upside
opportunities: Revenue grew about 28% last year with a 22% operating margin
Florida population growth adds customers every year
A dividend yield around 4% with a long record of increases
watch: Florida customer growth and Nova Scotia regulatory decisions.
